profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer @ Target | Mobile Ad Tech
profile.summary: I am always looking for the opportunity to challenge myself, and to bring innovation where ever my career may take me. I am open and willing to embrace any technologies that can get the job done in an efficient and stable manner while keeping scalability in mind.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, Digital Ads - Android
Sr. Software Engineer, Team Lead - Android
positions.description:
Technical Team Lead of the Products App used by store associates at Lowe’s across the United States and Canada.

My responsibilities include:

- Technical design of mobile apps

- Interfacing and collaboration across the entire tech stack found at Lowe’s (front end and back end)

- Working along side business to identify and address problems that need to be tackled.

- Leading teams of engineers on best practices in regards to coding and testing to ensure high quality applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Android
positions.description:
Worked on the exciting new International app for Royal Caribbean as an Android Engineer. My responsibilities include:

- Maintaining strong, clear communications and consistent collaboration with the product owners, designers, scrum masters on what needs to be achieved with the application.

- Interfacing with Enterprise Architecture & Infrastructure teams on strategic designs and initiatives.

- Helping refine user flows and application architecture as complexity continues to scale with best industry practices (Clean architecture, reactive programming, functional programming) where applicable.

- Mentoring junior developers and helping them understand and achieve expected responsibilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Led intiative to introduce new industry standards onto existing company practices (I.E. Using Docker Containers, better source control tools, etc..)

- Designed and created REST and SOAP web services in Spring.

- Built internal applications utilizing Oracle ADF, Spring MVC, jQWidgets

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern (Android)
positions.description:
- Implemented enhancements and new features into the Android client of Unify's Circuit application.

- Performed testing, and QA with Android, Web and iOS versions of the Circuit application

- Gain familiarity with Agile software development.

positions.title: CAPTURE Mentor
positions.description:
The Computer Accelerated Pipeline To Unlock Regional Excellence (CAPTURE) program is a collaborative effort between Florida Atlantic University (FAU), Broward College (BC) and Palm Beach State College (PBSC), to identify appropriate courses that will count toward an AA or an AS degree and then transfer to either a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (BSCS) or a Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering (BSCE) degree program at FAU. The goal of the collaboration is to enhance the quality of advising, instruction and educational opportunities for students to help them graduate and go on to have successful careers in computer-related fields.

Tasks as a Capture Mentor:

- Tutor any incoming freshmen, or transfer students in the field of computer engineering/science

- Mentor the students by giving them success tips, strategies, and even personal support

honors.title: Faculty Outstanding Leadership Award
honors.description: Awarded by the Dean of the College of Engineering. Award presented to one graduating senior in each engineering discipline
honors.issuer: Issued by Mohammad Ilyas Ph.D - Dean · Aug 2016

honors.title: Florida Atlantic University Deans List 2014
honors.description: Given to undergraduate students who completed a full-time load (at least 12 credits) with a grade point average of 3.0 or higher and must rank in the upper 10 percent of the students enrolled in the college
honors.issuer: Issued by Mohammad Ilyas, Ph.D. - Dean · Dec 2014
